Claire Park: Heads-up: weird gap in onboarding playbook runs — some accounts never got assigned health_bucket after CRM import. Seeing ~950 accounts where legacy_tag exists but health_bucket=NULL.
Ravi Shah: Can you paste a quick sample query?
Claire Park: `SELECT id, legacy_tag FROM crm.accounts WHERE legacy_tag IS NOT NULL AND (health_bucket IS NULL OR health_bucket='') LIMIT 50;`
Ellen Brooks: Likely import transform missed some variants (empty string, 'n/a', JSON blobs). Short fix: normalize legacy_tag on staging and run a preview join to mapping table.
audit-bot: Suggested command: `/audit preview-mapping --map=legacy->bucket_v2 --limit=1000` -> expected_preview=942
Ravi Shah: Plan: 1) normalization script to extract tag text from JSON blobs, 2) dry-run update to preview affected owners, 3) add backfill_run_id to rows on update, 4) run during low traffic window Sun 03:00 UTC.
Ellen Brooks: I'll own the normalization (Python). Minimal snippet: `def norm(s): try: return json.loads(s)[0]['tag'] if s.startswith('[') else s.strip().lower()`
Claire Park: Please also include a small pilot of 200 accounts with owner notification before full run.
Ravi Shah: Agreed. I'll prepare rollback SQL and idempotent update that writes to cs_audit.backfill_log. Posting files to drive when ready.
Claire Park: Uploaded mapping: https://drive.redwood.com/cs/legacy_map_2025_v2.csv. Ping when staging preview is done. Thanks!
